purpose: Anchor the completed Runtime 0.2.6.52 fallback multi-ingress synchronization from the development source into the standalone distributable AI-Bridge product repository. Public PR validation, main artifact publication, release verification, and fresh Windows GitHub install smoke have passed; explicit real end-user environment acceptance remains a separate gate.

live_runtime_at_capture.note: The development source and public product are validated at Runtime 0.2.6.52; the developer's active installed Runtime remains 0.2.6.51 because this source/public-repository synchronization intentionally did not switch the live installation.

excluded_from_this_completion: create a genuinely new per-install GitHub Bus through Setup UI
interactive GitHub authorization in the end-user flow
connect the newly provisioned Bus to the installed Runtime
install/activate Houdini Adapter in that fresh end-user installation
verify live Houdini round-trip through the fresh installation
acceptance.rule: Do not call the standalone product fully end-to-end accepted until these explicit real-environment checks pass.

safe_copy: ordinary Runtime bug fixes whose product path has not diverged
Houdini Adapter kernel fixes whose distributable semantics are unchanged
tests that remain generic and contain no developer-machine state
rebase_required: any file already productized differently in AI-Bridge
do_not_distribute: candidate or project-family knowledge as generic execution authority
delta_policy.knowledge_rule: Never incrementally copy development Knowledge. Regenerate distributable Knowledge from the latest source Knowledge tree using the clean filter and canonical digest contract after each accepted delta synchronization.
delta_policy.post_sync_rule: After a successful delta sync and validation, advance this baseline to the reconciled source commit and record old/new baseline plus validation evidence in CHANGELOG.md.
